observation.text:
I awake in a world unknown. There's a paper written in an ancient script: 'The past is gone, the future unwritten. Every step, every decision, shapes what lies ahead. Adventure, danger, and discovery await. Step forward and let the journey begin.' Suddenly, the paper bursts into flames, leaving no trace behind.

Current Time: 0001-01-01 08:00:00
Current Location: Ashen Bastion, courtyard

I waited for a while.
The world lies in ash and iron. Demon robots — infernal machines fused with hellfire and rusted malice — stalk the ruins of civilization. You are a scavenger turned soldier, recruited by alex_smith to push back the mechanical tide. Begin at the Ashen Bastion, humanity's last outpost, and forge a path through the scorched wastes to the Devils Foundry, where the war engines are born. Destroy their source, or perish in the attempt.You arrive at the Ashen Bastion, the last fortified outpost standing against the demon robot horde. alex_smith told you to report to old_marshal for your first assignment. The bastion is battered but still holds. Explore, gather your bearings, and prepare for what lies beyond the walls.

Chapter goal: Complete your orientation at the Ashen Bastion.

available_actions.name: action_attack
available_actions.description: The agent attacks a designated NPC in the current area; deals single-round damage based on agent's attack power. If NPC is in 'defend' state, damage is reduced to 25%.

available_actions.name: action_buy
available_actions.description: Buy a specified amount of an object from a merchant NPC using coins.

available_actions.name: action_craft
available_actions.description: The agent crafts a specified amount of an object if all necessary ingredients and dependencies are met.

available_actions.name: action_defend
available_actions.description: The agent takes a defensive stance. If attacked by an NPC while defending, damage received is reduced to 10%. Defending also partially recovers stamina.

available_actions.name: action_discard
available_actions.description: The agent discards a specified amount of an object from a designated container or inventory.

available_actions.name: action_drop
available_actions.description: The agent drops an object from hand to the current area.

available_actions.name: action_enter
available_actions.description: The agent enters a designated neighboring area; if the path is locked, a key is required to unlock it. Cannot leave during active combat.

available_actions.name: action_equip
available_actions.description: The agent equips an object from hand, either as armor or as the inventory container.

available_actions.name: action_inspect
available_actions.description: The agent inspects an object to obtain its text content, or inspects inventory to see its contents.

available_actions.name: action_jam
available_actions.description: Jam a held object into an enemy war machine's exposed mechanisms during active combat. The object is destroyed, but it permanently disables one action from the NPC's combat pattern cycle. The NPC must have more than one action remaining in its pattern. Heavier and more valuable objects have a higher chance of disabling an 'attack' action.

available_actions.name: action_overload
available_actions.description: Overload a held devil-forged component onto your equipped armor, permanently sacrificing the component to grant a reactive damage aura. Each combat round when an enemy NPC attacks you, the aura automatically deals counter-damage equal to a percentage of your defense stat. Eligible components: hellcoal, devil_oil, demon_core_shard, brimite_ore, hellcoal_concentrate, fiend_plate. Stronger components grant a higher aura percentage. The aura stacks across multiple overloads.

available_actions.name: action_pick_up
available_actions.description: The agent picks up an object from the current area.

available_actions.name: action_rally
available_actions.description: Rally a friendly NPC in the current area by spending coins, temporarily converting them into a combat ally. The rallied ally automatically deals bonus damage to any enemy the agent attacks for the next 3 combat rounds. Cost scales with the NPC's level.

available_actions.name: action_salvage
available_actions.description: Salvage defeated war machine remains from the current area using a repair_kit held in hand. Consumes scrap materials to extract devil-forged components that permanently upgrade your stats. Salvageable materials: scrap_iron (x2) or cog (x2) → +3 attack; fiend_plate (x1) or demon_core_shard (x1) → +2 defense.

available_actions.name: action_scavenge
available_actions.description: Scavenge the current area to discover hidden objects buried in the ruins. Your knowledge of war machine hiding spots — gained from defeating unique enemy types — increases both the chance and quality of findings. Each area can only be scavenged once every few steps.

available_actions.name: action_sell
available_actions.description: Sell a specified amount of an object to a merchant NPC. Payout is 0.5 times the real value of the objects.

available_actions.name: action_siphon
available_actions.description: Siphon residual dark energy from an enemy NPC mid-combat by sacrificing a held object as a conduit. The object is consumed. HP is restored equal to the object's coin value, and the NPC's attack power is reduced by a third of that value for the rest of the encounter. Requires active combat with the target NPC and a valued object held in hand.

available_actions.name: action_store
available_actions.description: The agent stores a specified amount of an object into a designated container or inventory.

available_actions.name: action_take_out
available_actions.description: The agent takes out an object from a designated container or inventory into hand.

available_actions.name: action_talk_to
available_actions.description: The agent talks to a designated NPC in the current area to receive dialogue.

available_actions.name: action_unequip
available_actions.description: The agent unequips an equipped object back into hand.

available_actions.name: action_wait
available_actions.description: The agent waits for a while without taking any action. During combat, waiting fully recovers stamina.

available_actions.name: action_write
available_actions.description: The agent writes text on a writable object, if holding writing tools.
